0022600199.text: The Mavericks (4-4, on a two-game losing streak) host the Brooklyn Nets (2-6, coming off a win) in a game where Dallas sits 11th in the West and Brooklyn is 13th in the East. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise). Dallas won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 123-114 win in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026, and the teams have not yet played each other in the 2026-27 season.
